programme.title: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Trinity College of Arts & Sciences); 15 major units, 34 units total; revised requirements for first-years matriculating Fall 2026
programme.how_found: Department of Computer Science site cs.duke.edu -> Undergraduate -> Degrees -> BS (URL found by site search on duke.edu). A BA in Computer Science also exists (its page is marked DRAFT).
programme.notes: US university: english, deadline, gpa, aid come from the university-wide undergraduate admissions page (admissions.duke.edu/apply/), tuition from the Karsh Office of Undergraduate Financial Support, scoped to the university (owner ruling). No CS-specific admission: students declare the major after matriculating.

english.notes: Recommended, not required: 'If you are a non-native English speaker or if you are not currently studying in an English-medium curriculum, we recommend but do not require that you take an English proficiency test.' Expected minimums if taken: TOEFL '100 on the internet-based TOEFL', Duolingo 130, PTE Academic 70, Cambridge C1/C2 180. No per-section minimums.

gpa.notes: No first-year GPA minimum. Prose: 'We look at the courses you’ve taken from what’s available to you, individual grades in academic courses, overall GPA, and class rank (when available).' (The 3.7 college GPA on the same page is for transfer applicants.)

deadline.notes: 'The information below represents the 2026-27 admission cycle requirements and deadlines.' Year not printed next to the date. 'There is no separate application for international students.' Early Decision: November 2. No timezone printed.

value.population: first-year undergraduate students (no separate international rate)

tuition.quote: 2026-2027 Estimated Cost of Attendance* (Before Financial Aid) 1st-year Undergraduate Student Billed Costs Tuition $73,740
tuition.notes: Estimated fees $3,019; total billed $98,788 - $98,848; estimated total cost of attendance $103,180 - $103,975. 2027/28 not published.

value.name: Duke merit scholarships (Office of Undergraduate Scholars and Fellows; Robertson Scholars Program)

scholarship_exists.quote: Duke offers a small number of merit scholarships for which all applicants to Duke are automatically considered.
scholarship_exists.notes: Competitive; no separate application. Need-based aid also exists; for foreign citizens it must be requested in the original first-year application and that pool is 'more highly selective'.

scholarship_international.quote: Duke offers need-based financial aid and merit-based scholarships to US citizens and to foreign citizens following the different policies outlined below.
scholarship_international.notes: 'Foreign citizens must apply for need-based financial aid in the original first-year application in order to be eligible for need-based funding from Duke at any point'. Not for international transfer students.
